how_adapted: Copied verbatim (plus a one-line attribution header comment) through the browser (raw view, copy/paste). Used as the base stylesheet for the web UI (.container, #cards-container, .parent-card column/card styles); overrides are in src/static/app.css (own code).
notes: Backend (src/server.js, src/main.js) and UI logic (src/static/app.js, index.html, app.css) written from scratch: GitHub searches for framework-free Node Kanban backends found only Express/MongoDB-based projects, and the vanilla-JS UI candidate scazzy/kanban-board has no license.
